services.intro: We're an AI consulting and development company working with small and mid-size businesses in Indiana, across the United States, and worldwide. The work is wider than any menu: finding where hours and money leak in an operation, then fixing it with software, data, and AI. Quoting that takes days, calls that go unanswered, paperwork that eats a team, a business invisible on Google and in ChatGPT, a system nobody wants to touch — that's the kind of problem we take.

aiConsultancy.problem: Every consultancy will tell you AI changes everything. Almost none will tell you, in numbers, what it's worth in YOUR operation — before you commit to building anything. We do the analysis first: your processes, your data, your costs. Then we show you where AI pays, what it costs to capture, and how we'd measure success. If the numbers don't work, we tell you that too.

demo.heading: What an audit actually finds.

rows.label: the situation
rows.body: A contract beverage manufacturer runs 70–80% of its volume through one robotic line. Schedulers hand-price every short run, and quoting takes days.

rows.label: the model
rows.body: Our model was built from their public statements and industry benchmarks, then corrected live with their real numbers.

rows.label: the finding
rows.body: Even at the most conservative baseline, it showed an RFQ-and-scheduling engine returning its cost in under nine months.

demo.closing: Every audit works the same way: your operation, your numbers, a sensitivity table that includes the case where we tell you not to build.

aiSearchVisibility.problem: Nearly half of consumers now ask AI assistants for recommendations, and most businesses never appear in the answers. The work that fixes it is measurable: we test the exact prompts your customers use, show you where you stand, do the technical and content work both Google and AI engines reward, and re-test on a schedule you can verify yourself.

demo.heading: Try it right now.
steps: Ask for the best option in your category and city.
If you're not in the answer, that's the problem.
demo.closing: Nearly half of consumers now ask AI tools for local recommendations. Being excellent on Google no longer means you exist where a growing share of your customers actually ask.

steps.label: Baseline
steps.body: We run a fixed set of twenty prompts your buyers would use, three times each across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity, and record exactly where you stand. You get the prompt set on day one.

steps.label: Foundation
steps.body: The technical and entity work both rails reward: structured data, crawlability (graded by our own tool), citations, reviews, consistency everywhere your business is named.

steps.label: Content
steps.body: Pages and answers built for how engines actually retrieve, validated against real search volume before anything is written.

steps.label: Re-measure
steps.body: Same prompts, every month, in your report. Run them yourself any time.

price.note: Google and AI search, worked as one program. Measured monthly against a fixed prompt set you can run yourself.

measurement.heading: You hold the yardstick.
measurement.body: The prompt set is fixed on day one and never changes without your sign-off. Outputs vary run to run, so we measure three runs per prompt and report the rate across all three. There is no proprietary “visibility score”. The report states whether you were named, where, and what you were cited from. We can't fake this and wouldn't try.

faq.question: Can you guarantee I'll show up in ChatGPT?
faq.answer: No, and nobody honestly can. The systems are non-deterministic. What we guarantee is the measurement: you'll know exactly where you stand, before and after, verifiably.

faq.question: Is this different from SEO?
faq.answer: It's SEO plus the AI rail, worked as one program. Most of the foundational work overlaps, which is why we don't sell them separately.

faq.question: How fast do results show?
faq.answer: Technical fixes register in weeks; content and citation work compounds over 60–90 days and keeps compounding.

about.intro: Nahl Technologies is an AI consulting and implementation firm in Indianapolis, Indiana, serving businesses across North America, the Gulf region, Central Asia, and New Zealand. The firm builds AI workflow automation, custom software, and fast, search-ready websites, and publishes its research openly. It also makes two products of its own: Crawlmouse, a free website auditor, and Hafsa Sastho, a Bengali-language maternal and infant health app.
storyParagraphs: Nahl (نحل) is Arabic for honeybee — small, relentless, and useful far beyond its size.

Nahl Technologies was started by two immigrants who came to the United States with little more than a plan to learn. Udaay Sikder earned his BS and MS in Computer Science here and has spent his career in the tech industry; Mohieminul Khan earned his PhD in Mechanical Engineering and brings five years of industry experience. One of us builds software; the other builds systems. Together, that's the point.

We're proudly based in Indiana and we work with businesses everywhere, across the United States and around the world, helping them adopt AI and put it to work. We build with AI in every part of our own operation; that is how the company runs. The products we've shipped, the research we publish, and this website itself are the proof we'd rather show than tell.
The American dream, as far as we can tell, still works. You just have to build it.
whatWeDoParagraphs: We're an AI consulting and development company in Indianapolis. Most of our clients are small and mid-size businesses in Indiana and across the United States. Some are further away than that.

The work varies. One month it's helping a manufacturer quote faster. Another it's a website rebuild, an intake automation for a clinic, or figuring out why a business never comes up when people ask ChatGPT for recommendations. We don't keep a narrow menu. If the problem involves software, data, or AI, send it over and we'll tell you whether we can help and what it would cost. Our pricing is public. So is the research behind how we work.
whatWeBuiltParagraphs: The easiest way to judge us is by what we ship for ourselves. Crawlmouse is our free audit tool. It shows what AI crawlers can actually see on a website, and the data from hundreds of audits became our first published research report. Hafsa Sastho (হাফসা স্বাস্থ্য) is a Bengali-language maternal health app for mothers in Bangladesh, launching on Google Play September 1, 2026. We started the company to build it.
We're a young company. Our early clients get founding rates and more attention than they probably expect. That part won't last forever.

lead: We are Nahl Technologies, an AI consulting and implementation firm based on the northeast side of Indianapolis. We work with small and mid-size businesses across the 317 — Indianapolis, Carmel, Fishers, Greenwood, Zionsville, and anywhere within about 45 minutes of the city — plus remote clients across Indiana and the rest of the country.

Here is the short version of how we are different, in numbers you can check: our prices are published on this website, almost all of them. Every engagement starts with a free 30-minute AI opportunity scan. A full audit is $2,500, fully credited toward your first project. Scoped automation and software builds go live in 75 days, or your money back.

method.heading: What AI consulting actually looks like here
method.intro: A lot of AI consulting is a strategy deck and an invoice. Ours works in four steps, and each step produces something you can hold:

steps.label: Observe.
steps.body: We study how your business actually runs — intake, quoting, scheduling, paperwork, reporting. Not how the org chart says it runs.

steps.label: Quantify.
steps.body: We put numbers on the problems: hours spent, response times, error rates, cost per task. You get ROI math you can check against your own books before anything gets built.

steps.label: Build.
steps.body: Workflow automation, AI agents, custom software, or a faster website — whichever the numbers point to. Fixed price, written scope, agreed before work starts.

steps.label: Measure.
steps.body: We compare the result against the numbers we promised. If we told you a quoting workflow would save fifteen hours a week, we count the hours.

method.closing: If the scan or the audit shows there is nothing worth building in your business right now, we say so and you have lost a coffee break. That happens, and saying it is cheaper for both of us than a project that should not exist.

proof.heading: Proof you can check before you call
items: Our own website is our work sample. It scores 100/100 on AI-readiness, loads in under a second, and every claim on it is sourced. We build client sites to the same standard.
We publish original research. We audited 187 small-business websites and published the findings openly, with the dataset licensed for anyone to use. Half of those sites have pages nothing links to.

We build products in the same shop. Crawlmouse is our free website auditor — over 250 audits run. Hafsa Sastho is our Bengali-language maternal health app. We do not sell anything we cannot build ourselves.
You can read our prices right now. No call required to hear a number.

audience.heading: Who this is for
audience.intro: Most of our Indianapolis-area clients look like one of these:
items: Manufacturers and job shops modernizing their operations — often businesses that invested in automated equipment and now generate data nobody reads, or run quoting and scheduling on spreadsheets and inboxes.
Service businesses where the owner is the bottleneck: intake, follow-up, invoicing, and scheduling eating hours that should go to customers.
Professional firms that need to be findable — on Google and, increasingly, when someone asks ChatGPT or Gemini who to hire.
audience.closing: If you need a two-hundred-person enterprise program, larger Indianapolis firms like Resultant are built for that scale, and we will say so in the first call. If you want senior engineers finding and shipping the highest-ROI automation in a small or mid-size operation, that is exactly what we do.

items.question: How much does AI consulting cost in Indianapolis?
items.answer: With us: the first 30 minutes are free, a full audit is $2,500 with the fee fully credited toward your first project within 90 days, and scoped builds start at $6,000. Market-wide, Indianapolis AI consultants typically charge anywhere from around $150 per hour to five-figure monthly retainers, and many do not publish prices at all. We publish ours.

items.question: Do you come on-site?
items.answer: Yes, anywhere within about 45 minutes of Indianapolis, including Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Greenwood, Anderson, and Muncie. Beyond that we work remotely, and we serve clients across North America, the Gulf region, Central Asia, and New Zealand.

items.question: What does the 75-day guarantee cover?
items.answer: Any automation or software build with a written scope: if it is not live in production within 75 days of the scope being signed, you get your money back. It does not apply to audits (which have their own promise: the fee is credited to your first project) or to ongoing SEO and AI-visibility work, where no honest firm can guarantee outcomes it does not control.

items.question: We already use ChatGPT. Why would we need a consultant?
items.answer: Using AI tools and getting ROI from AI are different jobs. The value is rarely in the chat window; it is in wiring AI into your intake, quoting, scheduling, and reporting so work that eats staff hours happens on its own. That is plumbing, and plumbing is what we build.

items.question: Can you make our business show up in ChatGPT and Google's AI answers?
items.answer: That is one of our core services — AI search visibility. We do the machine-readable identity work, the content, and the citation building that AI assistants draw from, and we measure it weekly. What we will not do is guarantee a ranking or a citation, because nobody controls those systems, and anyone who guarantees them is guessing.

items.question: What industries do you know?
items.answer: Manufacturing and job shops, logistics, professional services, and local service businesses. Our research corpus — the 187-site study and 250+ Crawlmouse audits — is built almost entirely from small and mid-size American businesses.

lead: Nahl Technologies is an AI consulting and implementation firm in Indianapolis that works with small and mid-size manufacturers: job shops and contract manufacturers, medical device makers, custom machine builders, and plastics processors. We find where AI genuinely recovers money in a plant's front office and paperwork, then build it, with ROI math you can check against your own books before anything gets built.

Most of Indiana is within a morning's drive of us, and we come to the floor. We also work remotely with manufacturers across North America, and our published research covers exactly the problems this page describes.

gap.heading: The execution gap on the shop floor's other side
paragraphs: Manufacturers automated the floor a generation before everyone else. Cobots, CNC, vision systems. What mostly has not been automated is the other side of the wall: quoting from RFQs, proposal engineering, quality system paperwork, and the process data that gets collected and never read. That is where we work. The machines are rarely the constraint anymore. The office around them is.

One credential worth stating plainly, because manufacturers in regulated work ask: before founding this firm, our CEO built software inside regulated digital health environments, where documentation is not an add-on to the work but the shape of it. FDA-registered and ISO 13485 shops will recognize what that experience means.
